title: OT/IT cybersecurity for machine network integration
brief: When machines actually go on-network (MTConnect/OPC-UA), unsecured pipes are a liability. mTLS + VLAN segmentation + intrusion-detection signatures gate the real-time loop (MS22).

units.title: VLAN segmentation: OT vs IT, no L3 routing without firewall
exit_conditions: MTConnect/OPC-UA traffic isolated to OT VLAN
no direct routing OT->IT except through firewall
tests: tcpdump from IT side sees zero MTConnect packets
units.description: Network architecture, not code. Document in operations runbook.

units.title: mTLS for MTConnect/OPC-UA streams
exit_conditions: all MTConnect/OPC-UA endpoints require client cert
units.description: Standard mTLS. Use existing PKI if any, else generate ephemeral CA.

units.title: IDS signature: unauthorized G-code injection detection
exit_conditions: IDS rule fires on G-code byte stream entering OT VLAN from outside MS22 ingest endpoint

acceptance: MTConnect/OPC-UA traffic mTLS-encrypted; OT VLAN segmented from IT VLAN with firewall; intrusion-detection signature for unauthorized G-code injection alerts within 5s of staged event.

risks.description: JM Die may not have segmented network; mitigation = PRISM ships secure-by-default config + customer onboarding requires VLAN verification
